name: table
note: The two-minute Act 2 run at the judging table. Press at 0:30 of the pitch; the first op must land by 1:45, 75 s after the press. Nothing here claims a finished head.

brief.marker: Podium head for the same Perch
brief.text: Make the Podium head for the same Perch: the same ESP32-S3 upright, a 2.4 mm lid, the same fits, the same 180 mm bed. Reuse the arm and the mount. Recall the Perch we just built before planning, and use what its review found. Podium_Body -> lead-claude, Podium_Lid -> lid-creao.

gate.if_missed: No part has started yet. The recall and the tasks are real; the body is the next run.
